lines.text: In Josiah's days, God gave faithless Israel a certificate of divorce, and her sister Judah saw it but feared nothing.
God told Jeremiah to proclaim toward the south, "Return," and promised to bring one from a city and two from a family to Zion.
God promised shepherds after His own heart, and the nations would call Jerusalem The Throne of the LORD.
God said Judah would walk with the house of Israel, and He had hoped they would call Him Father.
God told the men of Judah and Jerusalem to circumcise their hands to the LORD, or His wrath would burn like fire.
